events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I'm acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can't confirm which underlying AI model I run on. This chat's logging and who can view it aren't something I can see from here.

If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll reset your password. The reset link will go to the phone registered to your account.
